verdict.rationale: Dagster natively supports scheduling recurring jobs via Schedules (cron/interval-based) and event-driven Sensors, plus Declarative Automation for dependency-based execution — all well-documented first-party features, and AI-native usage is supported via the dagster-mcp server and AI skills for coding agents to build/manage these pipelines. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability of scheduling in production and no explicit example of an AI agent invoking a schedule via MCP.
